roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/empty-first-run/) with this contract beside it, and the app-shell example it renders into components/patterns/app-shell/ (kept if you already have it). You own the copies: pass your nav through shell, replace the plans and sample rows, wire onCreate and onOpenSetup, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: First run of a billing workspace inside the app-shell example (inset): PageHeader Invoices with no action, and one Card at layout-container-sm holding Empty (first-use, lg) with Create invoice (the one solid primary) and Try sample data (outline), then one setup line under a Divider: a count, what's left and Open setup (ghost) to the page with SetupGuide. Create invoice opens a Modal (md) that adds a new customer inline (Combobox allowCustomValue), with Plan (Select) and Due date (DatePicker); Create draft hands the draft to onCreate and shows a Toast. Try sample data swaps Empty for an info Alert (Sample data, Clear sample data) over the invoices Table, and Create invoice moves to PageHeader.
useWhen: The first visit to a list that has no records yet, where one create action gets someone started
A new workspace that should offer sample data without filling the real list
A page that should show setup progress in one line while the task list lives elsewhere
doNotUseWhen: Guided setup across several steps — start from onboarding
A list that is empty because of filters or search — use Empty kind no-results in the list itself

breadcrumbs.note: PageHeader breadcrumbs. The demo has none: the shell's nav already shows Billing › Invoices.

onCreate.note: (invoice: { customer, newCustomer, plan, dueDate }) => void. Create draft in the Modal. Save the draft and open it from here; dueDate is YYYY-MM-DD. The demo lists the draft and shows a Toast.

setup.note: { done, total, left }: the setup line under Empty, like Setup 3 of 5 · Tax rates and payments left. null hides it once setup is done. Default: the demo's 3 of 5.

onOpenSetup.note: () => void. Open setup: go to the page that holds SetupGuide (Home in the demo).

shell.note: App shell props for your app (nav, workspace, account…), merged over EMPTY_FIRST_RUN_DEMO_SHELL.

must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps

Exactly one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view: Create invoice in Empty while the list is empty, in PageHeader once it has rows, and Create draft while the Modal is open (Create invoice turns outline)
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Wrap every labeled input in Field (label, hint, and error wiring)
The setup line is a count, what's left and one ghost Button to the page that holds SetupGuide; never render SetupGuide or its task list here
After Create draft, open the new record (onCreate is where your app routes to it)
Sample data is app data, marked by an info Alert with Clear sample data; it never counts as real invoices

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
defaults: Shell: the app-shell example (EMPTY_FIRST_RUN_DEMO_SHELL): layout inset, layout-shell--viewport; Northwind workspace, Home (3/5 badge) and Billing (Invoices, Customers, Plans), account Maya Chen
Header: PageHeader Invoices, subtitle Northwind · billed in USD, no action while empty
Empty: kind first-use, size lg, icon ReceiptText; No invoices yet / Each invoice bills one customer for a plan. Add the customer as you go.
Controls md 36 when wide; lg 40 below the shell's breakpoint, with the Empty actions stacked full width
Modal md: New invoice / Saved as a draft. Nothing is sent yet.; Customer (Combobox, new name inline), Plan (Select), Due date (DatePicker); Cancel, then Create draft
Sample data: three rows (Paid, Open, Overdue in words) in a Table with stack below 480px

requirements: Landmarks: SideNav is nav; PageHeader h1 and Empty sit in main. Narrow, the menu Button opens the nav in the kit Drawer
Tab order follows reading: Create invoice, Try sample data, Open setup. Same order when stacked
Setup count is text; Open setup has aria-describedby on the setup line, so it reads what's left
Modal: focus starts on Customer, Escape closes and focus returns to Create invoice; Field carries the error
When Try sample data, Clear sample data or Create draft swaps Empty and the Table, focus moves to Create invoice in its new place
Sample data is an info Alert (status role) titled Sample data with an icon, never a tint alone; statuses in the Table are words

doNot: Do not render SetupGuide or a setup checklist on this page; link to it
Do not add a second solid primary for sample data or setup
Do not mix sample rows into real counts or exports
